title: Hadith on Trust in Allah
summary: The hadith emphasizes trusting Allah for sustenance like birds do.
translation: Allah Almighty blesses those endowed with trust in Him, granting them abundantly when they truly rely on Him. This is learned by staying with elders and reading stories of the companions. There is a hadith where Umar radiAllahu ta'ala 'anhu says he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'If you were to rely upon Allah with proper reliance, He would provide for you just as He provides for birds. They go out hungry in the morning and return with full stomachs in the evening.'
